recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, surrealist composition featuring a heavily distorted, glowing white organic shape resembling a human face or skull set against a deep black background. The central form contains two small, rectangular photographic inserts of a group of people, creating a scale-defying collage effect typical of late 1960s psychedelic art.
coreVisualRelationships: High-contrast figure-ground relationship between the glowing white form and black void.
Juxtaposition of large-scale abstract organic shapes with small-scale realistic photography.
Visual tension created by the melting, asymmetrical distortion of the central facial features.
coreInvariants: Deep black negative space surrounding the central form.
Rectangular photographic windows embedded within the abstract form.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: A large, vertically oriented distorted head shape dominates the center, occupying approximately 70% of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central white mass acts as the primary anchor, with the small photographic inserts serving as secondary focal points.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the bright central mass, moves to the small photographic details, and then follows the melting contours down to the bottom edge.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive black negative space on all sides, emphasizing the 'floating' quality of the subject.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep black background providing extreme contrast.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Luminous off-white/pale grey for the central distorted form.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Muted, naturalistic tones within the small photographic inserts.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Extreme value contrast with very low saturation, creating a stark, moody atmosphere.

letterConstructionRules: Extremely heavy weight with minimal counters.
Irregular, hand-drawn baseline and cap height.
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters like 'O' and 'C' are nearly closed circles with thick strokes.
Vertical strokes have a slight wobble or swell.

composition.relationshipToImage: placed over the black negative space

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Pair the bold, liquid display type with tiny, clean sans-serif metadata in the corners for a professional record-label look.
graphicDevices: Soft glow/halation around the central object

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the liquid, rounded weight of the era.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a surrealist image with a deep black background. In the center, place a large, glowing, off-white organic shape that looks like a melting, distorted human face or skull. Embed two small, sharp rectangular color photographs of a group of people standing outside within the white mass—one in the upper left 'eye' area and one in the mid-right area.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add custom hand-lettered text in the upper left corner using a thick, bulbous, white psychedelic font. Add small, technical sans-serif metadata in the upper right corner.

verificationChecks: Is the central form sufficiently distorted and glowing?
Are the photo inserts small and rectangular?
Is the typography bulbous and liquid-like?

mustAchieve: Soft, organic edges on the central form
avoid: Sharp vector edges on the central form
Clean, modern sans-serif for the main title

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the white form does not look like a literal skull but an abstract suggestion of one.
Check that the text is legible despite its heavy, liquid distortion.
Verify the scale difference between the large head and tiny photo inserts is dramatic.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [abstract organic central mass] + [high contrast black background] + [embedded micro-photography] + [liquid psychedelic typography] to create a vintage surrealist aesthetic.
